Visitor replaces form with custom output

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    class _TestVisitor:
        def visit_form(self, ctx, action_url, method):  # noqa: ANN001, ANN202, ARG002
            return {"type": "custom", "output": "[FORM PLACEHOLDER]"}
    html = '<div><form action="/submit" method="POST"><label>Name: <input type="text" name="name"></label><button type="submit">Submit</button></form></div>'
    result = convert(html, visitor=_TestVisitor())
    print(result.content)

main()
```
